images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: 843 Toronto A

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a 1920s brick two-flat with stacked full-width porches on brick piers, two front doors, shingled gable, a ribbon drive along the side to a garage, a young street tree and shrubs

why.note: the stacked two-flat, Toledo's 1920s rental house
